section.46: The Book of Cutting off the Hand of the Thief

46.name_native: The Book of Cutting off the Hand of the Thief

hadiths.text: It was narrated that 'Aishah said:"A thief was brought to the hand." They said: "We did not think that you would take it so far." He said: "If it were Fatimah (who stole), I would cut off her hand
